message: Field "Post.count": native type "@db.Long" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: the stored BSON type then follows the field type. If "@db.Long" is not the default BSON type for Int, removing it also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client then writes the default type for new values, while stored documents keep the old one.

Field "Post.title": native type "@db.String" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: the stored BSON type then follows the field type. If "@db.String" is not the default BSON type for String, removing it also changes the Prisma 6 app: its client then writes the default type for new values, while stored documents keep the old one.

Field "Post.number": @db.ObjectId is only supported on a String field, and this field is "Int". Remove @db.ObjectId, or change the field type to String. Either change also reaches the Prisma 6 app: its client then writes and reads this field with the new type, while stored documents keep their ObjectId values.
